title: Real MultiSWAP N:1 live MODFLOW6 application qualification
predecessors: F-GC40 typed deterministic N:1 affine cell response
F-GC44 real one-column one-cell SWAP+MODFLOW6 application
goal: Qualify two independent real FMR/SWAP columns coupled to one live MODFLOW6 cell through the admitted F-GC40 cell-response reduction, same-origin corrector iteration, and fail-before-publication whole-window boundary.
decisions: No production physics change: this workunit is a composition/qualification layer over already-admitted production modules.
Use two independent real FMR committed lineages and participants, not cloned post-trial state.
Use distinct real soil hydraulic conductivities so the N:1 response is nontrivial while keeping the short F-GC44 numerical envelope.
Use exact area fractions that close to one and F-GC40 as the authoritative predictor aggregation.
All real SWAP correctors receive the same MODFLOW cell head and originate from each tile's immutable accepted checkpoint.
Convergence uses the area-weighted real SWAP corrector exchange against realized MODFLOW API exchange.
All tile and ledger preflights complete before MODFLOW finalize_time_step; then tile commits and ledgers publish in deterministic tile order.
invariants: one common coupling id, groundwater service/lineage/revision and window
F-GC40 slope/intercept is the only N:1 predictor reduction
predictor/corrector ownership remains below iMOD Coupler
no larger prescribed-head numerical envelope than F-GC44
no active drainage, root uptake, macropores, snow, soil temperature, Ribasim or irrigation
next_permitted_action: Implement a qualification-only two-tile same-process bridge using real FMR participants, F-GC40 predictor aggregation and live MODFLOW6 6.8.0; qualify aggregation, repeated same-origin correctors and publication ordering before any admission.
